subject: Transportation Systems
title: Lunar and Mars Transport
description: A micro-lesson that makes Lunar and Mars Transport usable.

hook.text: NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon. Getting there is the easy part—staying is hard.

buildup.text: The SLS rocket and Orion capsule carry crew to lunar orbit. SpaceX's Starship lands them on the surface.

discovery.text: A permanent Moon base would need regular cargo flights—fuel, food, and building materials sent continuously.

twist.text: Mars is far harder. A one-way trip takes 7 months. Everything must be carried or made on-site.

climax.text: In-situ resource use—making water and fuel from Martian soil and atmosphere—is the key to sustainable transport.

punchline.text: Going to space is transportation. Living there is logistics.

quiz.question: How long does a one-way trip to Mars take?
